affinity booster.name: Affinity Booster
affinity booster.foundText: Affinity Boosters doubles the amount of affinity earned from pickups and mission rewards.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Can be bought from the Market with Platinum. A 3-day booster costs 40 Platinum, a 7-day booster costs 80 Platinum, and a 30-day booster costs 200 Platinum. Can be obtained randomly from Daily Tribute. The booster's duration depends on the total amount of login days: (3 × [1 + Day ÷ 100]), to a cap of 93 hours from 3,000 days onward. 3-day boosters may also be obtained for free by the following methods: As a reward from daily Sorties or weekly Archon Hunts. As a reward from The Descendia. As a reward from The Circuit. Rare or Reinforced Storage Containers may reward a 30-minute or 1-hour variant respectively. A 90-day booster can be obtained by purchasing the Prime Access Complete or Accessories Pack. A 1-day booster can be obtained as a reward from the Void Surplus offering for sale by Baro Ki'Teer.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: *Can be bought from the Market with Platinum.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: After completing the Chains of Harrow quest, the Vesper Relay becomes a playable gamemode - Follie's Hunt. Completing Follie's Hunt will reward 15 Atramentum ( 25 in The Steel Path ). During Follie's Hunt, 12 Atramentum Balloons will spawn in, with each dropping 2 - 4 Atramentum ( 3 - 6 in The Steel Path ). Atramentum Balloons can only be destroyed with weapon damage; Atramentum Balloons are immune to ability damage. Atramentum is not affected by Resource Booster, Resourceful Retriever, or Loyal Retriever. Enemies in Follie's Hunt have a small chance to drop 1 Atramentum. This appears to be unaffected by abilities or augments that affect drop rates/chance, such as: Ore Gaze, Desecrate, Pilfering Strangledome, and Pilfering Swarm.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. brickie muon battery.name: Brickie Muon Battery
brickie muon battery.foundText: Brickie Muon Battery is a Resource extracted from Brickie, a Servofish found in ponds during warm weather in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Muon Batteries are acquired by dismantling Brickies caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Brickies available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Brickie yields one Muon Battery. Muon Batteries may also be acquired by breaking containers around the map.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Muon Batteries are acquired by dismantling Brickies caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Brickies available, and select the "Dismantle" option to extract the components.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Eidolon Teralysts and Eidolon Gantulysts will drop one Brilliant Eidolon Shard when captured at its final stage with a charged Eidolon Lure. Eidolon Hydrolysts will drop two Brilliant Eidolon Shards when captured at its final stage with a charged Eidolon Lure.

bronco incarnon genesis.name: Bronco Incarnon Genesis
bronco incarnon genesis.foundText: Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Bronco Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Bronco with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

charamote sagan module.name: Charamote Sagan Module
charamote sagan module.foundText: Charamote Sagan Module is a Resource extracted from Charamote, a Servofish found in cave hotspots during cold/warm weather in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Sagan Modules are acquired by dismantling Charamotes caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Charamotes available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Charamote yields one Sagan Module. They can also be acquired as a drop from taking down an Exploiter Orb, each loot yielding 7-8 units.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Charc Electroplax are acquired by cutting up Charc Eels caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Charc Eels available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Charc Eel cut yields one Charc Electroplax. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Charc Electroplax in bundles of 20 among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought for Platinum.

otherSections.text: Upon starting or joining a Clan, the blueprint for the Clan Key will be automatically added to the player's inventory and made available within the Foundry. The blueprint will be consumed during construction, but once claimed, the key remains present in the player's inventory, granting them Dojo access. otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Cranial Foremounts can be obtained by filleting Myxostomata through Daughter in the Necralisk. Cranial Foremounts can also be bought from Daughter from the "Daily Special" in exchange for Platinum. Note that the "Daily Special" wares are rotating, and Cranial Foremount may not be available. Cranial Foremounts can also be obtained through the Requiem Obelisks scattered throughout the Cambion Drift. otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Credit Boosters can be bought from the Market with Platinum. A 3-day booster costs 40 Platinum, a 7-day booster costs 80 Platinum, and a 30-day booster costs 200 Platinum. Can be obtained randomly from Daily Tribute. The booster's duration depends on the total amount of login days: (3 × [1 + Day ÷ 100]). Rare or Reinforced Storage Containers may reward a 30-minute or 1-hour variant. A 1-day booster can be obtained as a reward from the Void Surplus offering for sale by Baro Ki'Teer.

credits.foundText: Credits can also be obtained from killing enemies, breaking containers, and searching lockers. otherSections.text: Each mission on the Star Chart (with the exception of Free Roam) will give a base Credit Reward based on the starting enemy level of that mission without any mission/gameplay modifiers (e.g. Nightmare Mode, The Steel Path, Void Fissures, etc.):

crewman's boot.name: Crewman's Boot
crewman's boot.foundText: The blueprint can be purchased from The Business for 10,000 Standing, requiring the rank of Cove with Solaris United.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. crimson talent.foundText: Crimson Talent is a resource obtained by completing Scoria's Angel, Uranus Proxima.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: After completing Jade Shadows: Constellations, Scoria's Angel node becomes available. It can be started either from within Pontis Tower, or directly from Railjack Navigation. Additional Crimson Talent (up to 12?) can be rewarded by taking down all targets during the Ramsled transition phase.

crystal fragment.name: Crystal Fragment
crystal fragment.foundText: Crystal Fragments (Belric and Rania) are resources found in Mirror Defense at Tyana Pass on Mars. They are small pieces obtained from the Crystal caskets of Belric & Rania.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Belric and Rania Crystal Fragments can be acquired from Mirror Defense at Tyana Pass on Mars. A Mastery Rank of 3 is required to access Tyana Pass. Collecting 50 Citrine's Remnants awards 5 Crystal Fragments ( 7 on The Steel Path ), alternating between Belric's and Rania's Crystals each time. Each completed Rotation (defending each crystal once) awards 10 Crystal Fragments of both types ( 15 on The Steel Path ).

otherSections.heading: Acquisition

cubic diodes.name: Cubic Diodes
cubic diodes.foundText: Cubic Diodes are an uncommon resource that can be found from Eximus units on the Corpus Ice Planet tileset, primarily Europa. They can also be found in Empyrean missions as a possible loot drop.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Defeating The Fragmented Zelator boss in Effervo, Deimos during the Operation; which will drop 1 Curse of Hearing, or 2 on Steel Path. Defeating The Fragmented One superboss in Effervo, Deimos during the Operation; which will drop 2 Curse of Hearing.

cuthol tendrils.name: Cuthol Tendrils
cuthol tendrils.foundText: Cuthol Tendrils are a crafting Resource extracted from Cuthol, a freshwater fish found only in shallow ponds at night in Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Cuthol Tendrils are acquired by cutting up Cuthol caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk, select the desired amount of Cuthol available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Cuthol cut yields one Cuthol Tendril. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Cuthol Tendrils among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought with Platinum.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Devil's Cap can be harvested in the Deepmines Labs of the Critter Liberation Deepmines Bounty. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap at Rank 0 - Neutral. Deepmines Lab (Stage 2-5 zone in Critter Liberation bounty) Thunder-Button Weapons inflict Electricity Damage. The player's movement speed and melee attack speed increases, as if under the effects of Speed. Devil's Cap Weapons inflict Slash Damage. The player's eyes glow bright red. Damaging enemies will cosmetically sever limbs and create additional blood and gore effects. Weapons inflict Magnetic Damage. Player is followed by a group of Sprodlings that match their Warframe's colors. Vomval Trumpet Weapons inflict Tau Damage. Spawns a false Eidolon Vomvalyst that floats near the player.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: * can be harvested in the Deepmines Labs of the Critter Liberation Deepmines Bounty.

diluted thermia.name: Diluted Thermia
diluted thermia.foundText: Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Diluted Thermia is obtained by successfully closing Thermia fractures in the Orb Vallis during the event. It is obtained every time a player or their squad close 4 Thermia fractures using the same coolant canister, or by using 4 coolant canisters at once in a single fracture, which will yield one Diluted Thermia, affected by resource boosters and double-resource events but not affected by resource drop chance boosters. Said canister will then disappear, and the players will have to search for a new one if they want to continue closing fractures.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Dracroot can often be found near cliffs on the central island of Duviri, near Lonesome Outlook, Fair Shores Hamlet, Watershed Hamlet, Hermit Landing and Moirai Crossing. It can sometimes be found in the plants in Teshin's Cave.

dread incarnon genesis.name: Dread Incarnon Genesis
dread incarnon genesis.foundText: Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Dread Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Dread with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

otherSections.text: Dull Button can be harvested in the entrance caves of all Deepmines Bounties. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap at Rank 0 - Neutral. Deepmines Caves (Stage 1 zone in all bounties) Muck Bonnet Weapons inflict Toxin Damage. Reeking Puffball Weapons inflict Gas Damage. Player is surrounded by cloudy green effects. Dull Button Clears existing Mushroom effects. Violet's Bane Weapons inflict Viral Damage. Spawns four Clems that follow the player, but their gunfire will harmlessly phase through enemies.

echowinder anoscopic sensor.foundText: Anoscopic Sensor is a Resource extracted from Echowinder, a Servofish found in lakes during warm weather in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Anoscopic Sensors are acquired by dismantling Echowinders caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Echowinders available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Echowinder yields one Anoscopic Sensor.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Combining Amber and Azure creates an Emerald Archon Shard. Combining Tauforged Amber and Tauforged Azure creates a Tauforged Emerald Archon Shard. Combining three Emeralds creates a Tauforged Emerald Archon Shard. Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. emerald talent.name: Emerald Talent
emerald talent.foundText: Emerald Talent is a resource obtained by completing The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: After completing Jade Shadows: Constellations, The Kuva Wytch node becomes available. The mission can be started either from within Pontis Tower, or directly from Railjack Navigation. Completing The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima will reward 12 - 16 Emerald Talent ( 18 - 22 in The Steel Path ). Additional Emerald Talent (up to 11?) can be rewarded by taking down all targets during the Orowyrm transition phase.

otherSections.heading: Resource Drop Rate and Quantity Table
otherSections.text: It's taking longer than I calculated. This page is actively being worked on and may not be completely correct. Please assist in making this page accurate by adding more info. For guidance on performing research, see WARFRAME Wiki:Research. More research is needed. Extractor drop rates may be tied to Region Resource drop rates Main article: Region Resource These statistics represent 100 consecutive runs of the Titan Extractor on each of the 18 Star Chart regions. The quantity of a resource mined depends on the type and order of the resource in the planet's resource table. For example, on Venus, Zariman, and Ceres, Alloy Plate can be found, which rank first in the planet's resource table. The quantity mined ranges from 400 to 1200 units. On Sedna, Alloy Plate are in second place, and their yield drops to 300 to 900 units per run. Similar ranges for Alloy Plate are found on Pluto, Phobos, and Jupiter. Whether this variation in yield ranges is intended by the developer is unknown. Common Resources Salvage: Kuva Fortress (1st place), Jupiter (1st place), Mars (2nd place), Sedna (3rd place) = 600-1200 pieces Nano Spores: Deimos (1st place), Saturn (1st place), Eris (1st place) = 1200-1600 pieces, but Neptune (1st place) is an pieces Polymer Bundle: Uranus (1st place), Venus (2nd place) = 320-600 pieces, but Mercury (3rd place) = 260-436 pieces Alloy Plate: Venus (1st place), Zariman (1st place), Ceres (1st place) = 400-1200 pieces, but Sedna (2nd place), Pluto (4th place), Phobos (4th place), Jupiter (4th place) = 300-900 pieces Ferrite: Earth (1), Lua (1), Mercury (2), Neptune (2), Zariman (2) = 400-800 Uncommon Resources Plastids: Saturn (2), Uranus (2) = 120-200 and Eris (2), Pluto (3), Phobos (3) = 90-150 Rubedo: Pluto (1), Sedna (1), Phobos (1) and Europa (2), Earth (2), Lua (2) = 120-200 Circuits: Ceres (2), Venus (3) = 280-400, while Kuva Fortress (2) = 200-300 Rare and Research Resources The amount of resource mined does not vary much from planet to planet and ranges from 4-6. There's a peculiar table on the foreign wiki [ <span claim requires reference to a reliable source. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Cite">citation needed ] showing resource extraction chance ranges below. There's a theory that the resource extraction chance depends on its position in the planet's resource table, meaning resources ranked first are extracted more often than those ranked higher. For example, Nano Spores on Eris are ranked first, with a 79% extraction chance, Deimos (rank 1) with a 72% extraction chance, but the same Nano Spores on Neptune (rank 1) and Saturn (rank 1) are 13% and 43%, respectively. This theory is "confirmed" when we consider, for example, Polymer Bundles: Uranus (1) = 44%, Venus (2) = 35%, Mercury (3) = 19%. I think it's simpler and more effective to rely on the data in the tables, since the above theory has many nuances and shortcomings. otherSections.text: Gamma Berry can be harvested in the Deepmines Nutrient Plant of Weed The Garden Deepmines Bounty. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap, requiring Rank 2 - Curious. Deepmines Nutrient Plant (Stage 2-5 zone in Weed The Garden bounty) Blister Stalk Weapons inflict Heat Damage. Spawns six false Syzygy Shockwave MOAs that surround and follow the player while dancing in place. Thorn Tooth Weapons inflict Puncture Damage. Both the player and any enemies they damage will be impaled with ethereal Skana s. Gamma Berry Weapons inflict Radiation Damage. The player's head temporarily inflates. Weapons inflict Void Damage. Player is surrounded by Void energy, audible laughter plays on pickup, and the buff description reads "Is someone watching?"

otherSections.text: Goopolla Spleens are acquired by cutting up Goopolla caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Goopolla available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Goopolla cut yields one Goopolla Spleen. heciphron.name: Heciphron
heciphron.foundText: Heciphron is a gem that can be found in the Cambion Drift.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Heciphron can be acquired by mining blue mineral veins in the Cambion Drift. Heciphron is most commonly found within Albrecht's Prospect, initiating a Tier 2 Isolation bounty is recommended to get to more mining nodes within the area. The caves within the Catabolic Gutter provide a large quantity of mining nodes and a solid spread of rarities. Hitting the bonus zone while mining is helpful for acquiring Heciphron. Heciphron can also be acquired from doing Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift. Killing enemies with Operator correctly under the Requiem Obelisks effect. Umbra kills while in Operator form counts as Operator kill.

kriller thermal laser.name: Kriller Thermal Laser
kriller thermal laser.foundText: Kriller Thermal Laser is a Resource extracted from Kriller, a Servofish found in lakes during warm weather in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Thermal Lasers are acquired by dismantling Krillers caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Krillers available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Kriller yields one Thermal Laser. Thermal Lasers may also be acquired by breaking containers around the map.

kullervo's bane.name: Kullervo's Bane
kullervo's bane.foundText: Kullervo's Bane is a special resource from Duviri acquired from defeating Kullervo.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: In Duviri, players must travel to Kullervo's Hold, which only appears during the Anger, Fear, or Sorrow Spirals. In The Lone Story mode, Kullervo may appear as a Spiral event, while in The Duviri Experience, players must talk to The Warden to engage in combat with the Warframe (if the Warden doesn't spawn, progress the Spiral events until Kullervo appears). After defeating the Spiral's Orowyrm, Kullervo's Banes are awarded: 4 (30%), 5 (40%), or 6 (30%) are gained in Normal mode, while 6 (30%), 7 (40%), or 8 (30%) are gained in The Steel Path. These amounts are not affected by Resource Boosters. If you fight Kullervo after defeating the Orowyrm, the Kullervo's Banes are awarded immediately upon his defeat.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Kunai Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Kunai with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: ▾ Acquisition List ▾ The primary method for acquiring Kuva is through Kuva Siphon missions, of which there are two types available: the regular Kuva Siphon (mission level 25-35) and the Kuva Flood (mission level 80-100). Successfully destroying one Kuva Siphon will grant around 550-700, while the Kuva Flood will award 1100-1400. Kuva can be acquired in 100 or 300 units by doing Cetus Bounties, 500 units from Fortuna Bounties, and 750 from Necralisk Bounties. Sorties have a 12% chance to award 6,000 on completion of the third mission. Archon Hunts have a 12% chance to award 12,000 on completion of the third mission. Kuva Survival on Taveuni, Kuva Fortress rewards 200 for converting a Life Support Capsule into a Kuva Harvester and then defending it. Disruption on Tamu, Kuva Fortress awards 100 for Tier A, 200 for Tier B, and 350 for Tier C. In addition, Demolisher units drop 50 when killed. Downing a Kuva Larvling rewards 100. Using the Parazon on a Rank 1, 2, 3 and 4 Kuva Lich will respectively drop 150, 200, 250 and 300. Requiem Relics Have a chance to drop 1200. Nightwave awards 20,000 or 10,000 at certain ranks. Exact specifics may change with each new season. 10,000 can be purchased for 25 Vitus Essence from the Arbitrations Vendor in the Arbiters of Hexis room of any relay. 10,000 can be purchased for 15 Steel Essence from Teshin in the Conclave room of any relay. Kuva bought with Steel Essence has a purchase limit of 25 per week, for a total of 250,000. 50,000 can be purchased from The Steel Path Honors Shop for 55 Steel Essence when available once every 8 weeks ( Check availability on the The Steel Path page). 35,000 can be purchased weekly for 5 Voidplume Pinions from Archimedean Yonta in the Chrysalith Hub of the Zariman. 35,000 can be purchased weekly for 10 Riven Slivers from Palladino in Iron Wake. 5,000 can potentially be purchased weekly for 10 Pathos Clamps from Acrithis in the Dormizone after completing The Duviri Paradox, with a purchase limit of 1 per week. 6,000 can be purchased for 110 Beating Heartstrings from Flare in the Höllvania Central Mall after reaching Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh with The Hex, with a purchase limit of 7 per week, for a total of 42,000. 6,000 can be purchased for 100 Scuttler Husk from Acrithis in the Dormizone after completing The Hex quest, with a purchase limit of 7 per week, for a total of 42,000. 6,000 can be purchased for 75 Fergolyte from Nightcap in Fortuna after reaching Rank 3 - Seeker with Nightcap, with a purchase limit of 7 per week, for a total of 42,000. 6,000 can be purchased for 500 Atramentum from Aspirant Zorba in Relays, with a purchase limit of 7 per week, for a total of 42,000. 7,000 can be purchased for 35 Crimson Talent and 35 Emerald Talent from Hunhow in Pontis Tower after completing Jade Shadows: Constellations quest, with a purchase limit of 7 per week, for a total of 49,000. 10,500 can be purchased for 150 Entropic Kuva from Cephalon Melica in Yuvan Peak or the Zariman Ten Zero, with a purchase limit of 4 per week, for a total of 42,000. 20,000 can be selected as a The Steel Path The Circuit Tier 5 or 10 reward once per week. 35,000 can be obtained as a reward from the Void Surplus offering for sale by Baro Ki'Teer.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Mawfish Bones are acquired by cutting up Mawfish caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Mawfish available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Mawfish cut yields one Mawfish Bones. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Mawfish Bones in bundles of 20 among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought for Platinum.

mining.name: Mining
mining.foundText: The Sunpoint Plasma Drill is superior to the Nosam Cutters: it can mine Very Rare gems, includes the features of other Cutters, can be upgraded, and can be purchased earlier than most other Cutters as it does not require any Syndicate ranks.

otherSections.heading: Gear Acquisition
otherSections.text: Before players can begin mining, they must first acquire a Nosam Cutter from Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus for Ostron standing, or a Sunpoint Plasma Drill from Smokefinger in Fortuna for Solaris United standing. Players must then equip the mining tool in their Gear Wheel to use it. The Sunpoint Plasma Drill is superior to the Nosam Cutters: it can mine Very Rare gems, includes the features of other Cutters, can be upgraded, and can be purchased earlier than most other Cutters as it does not require any Syndicate ranks. It also has the slowest drill progress, making precise timing easier. It does, however, require at least 2,500 with Solaris United to be able to purchase, which could involve multiple Bounty Missions. Acquiring a Basic Nosam Cutter in Cetus for a much simpler 500 (low enough to be gained during Saya's Vigil ) and mining Venus gems that can be traded in for Standing is a quick way to get the Sunpoint Plasma Drill. Note that a Nosam Cutter and a Sunpoint Plasma Drill cannot be equipped at the same time.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Mortus Horns are acquired by cutting up Mortus Lungfish caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Mortus Lungfish available, and select the "Cut Fish" option to extract the components. Each Mortus Lungfish cut yields one Mortus Horn.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Completing Bounties given out by Mother. Finding them in the Cambion Drift. Trading random assortment of Cambion Drift resources under the Mend the Family option with Grandmother.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Muck Bonnet can be harvested in the entrance caves of all Deepmines Bounties. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap, requiring Rank 1 - Unknowing. Deepmines Caves (Stage 1 zone in all bounties) Muck Bonnet Weapons inflict Toxin Damage. Reeking Puffball Weapons inflict Gas Damage. Player is surrounded by cloudy green effects. Dull Button Clears existing Mushroom effects. Violet's Bane Weapons inflict Viral Damage. Spawns four Clems that follow the player, but their gunfire will harmlessly phase through enemies.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition

murkray liver.name: Murkray Liver
murkray liver.foundText: Murkray Liver is a Resource extracted from Murkray, saltwater fish rarely found in coastlines around Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Murkray Livers are acquired by cutting up Murkray caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Murkray available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Murkray cut yields one Murkray Liver. They can also occasionally drop from Tusk Thumper in quantities around 14 or so with a 33% drop rate

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Nonono can be harvested in the Deepmines Nutrient Plant of Weed The Garden Deepmines Bounty. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap, requiring Rank 2 - Curious. Deepmines Nutrient Plant (Stage 2-5 zone in Weed The Garden bounty) Blister Stalk Weapons inflict Heat Damage. Spawns six false Syzygy Shockwave MOAs that surround and follow the player while dancing in place. Thorn Tooth Weapons inflict Puncture Damage. Both the player and any enemies they damage will be impaled with ethereal Skana s. Gamma Berry Weapons inflict Radiation Damage. The player's head temporarily inflates. Weapons inflict Void Damage. Player is surrounded by Void energy, audible laughter plays on pickup, and the buff description reads "Is someone watching?"

norg brain.name: Norg Brain
norg brain.foundText: Norg Brain is a Resource extracted from Norg, freshwater fish found only at night in the large lake near Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Norg Brains are acquired by cutting up Norg caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Norg available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Norg cut yields one Norg Brain. Norg Brain can also drop from Tusk Thumpers on the Plains of Eidolon.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Ducats can be acquired by selling Prime blueprints, Prime weapon parts, and crafted Prime Warframe components at the Void Trader's Kiosks found in the Concourse area in Relays (except Maroo's Bazaar ). These Prime parts and blueprints, in turn, are acquired from Void Relics, or from trading with other players (note that Ducats themselves cannot be traded directly). To make up for the loss in rarity and thus value, such items are worth 25 and 65, respectively.

pigment.name: Pigment
pigment.foundText: A Pigment is a type of resource which appears as a small tetrahedron (three-sided pyramid) dropped by specific enemies.

otherSections.heading: Resource Boosters
otherSections.text: Resource Boosters and Resource Drop Chance Boosters increase the amount of Pigments that drop from enemies. Since the drop rate for Pigments from bosses is 100%, the drop chance is doubled to 200%, resulting in twice as much of the item being dropped. This effectively results in a 2x quantity multiplier when only one of either booster is active, and a 4x quantity multiplier when both are active. The drop chance boost from Dark Sectors stacks multiplicatively with the former multipliers, rounded down. Likewise, the resource bonuses from Void Fissures stack multiplicatively.

otherSections.heading: Resource Boosters
otherSections.text: *Resource Boosters and Resource Drop Chance Boosters increase the amount of Pigments that drop from enemies.

pix chip.name: Pix Chip
pix chip.foundText: Pix Chip are a rare resource found in Höllvania. They can be earned by Temporal Archimedea.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Awarded from Temporal Archimedea with certain research points. 28 Points (Elite): Pix Chip x 6 37 Points (Elite): Pix Chip x 9 Certain Peely Pix will reward an additional Pix Chip for completing a stage with the Pix equipped in exchange for an additional debuff, up to 3 extra Pix Chip s. Only 1 additional Pix Chip will be rewarded per stage; repeating a stage using a different Peely Pix will not give another Pix Chip. It Sees You periodically spawns a hostile Antimatter Drop that will chase you throughout the selected mission. Old Pizza gives any damage received during the selected mission a chance to inflict a Toxin proc. Optimism gradually builds up Cold procs every few seconds, freezing the player solid for 3 seconds if 10 procs are allowed to accumulate. Rolling or Void Slinging will remove 3 stacks. Once ten duplicates of a given Peely Pix have been obtained, enough to upgrade it to Chromatic, any excess copies obtained via Peely Paks are automatically converted to 1 Pix Chip each.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition

recaster neural relay.name: Recaster Neural Relay
recaster neural relay.foundText: Recaster Neural Relay is a Resource extracted from Recaster, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis, in Fortuna pond hotspots during cold weather.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Neural Relay is acquired by dismantling Recasters caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Recasters available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Recaster yields one Neural Relay. This resource also drops from containers in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Reeking Puffball can be harvested in the entrance caves of all Deepmines Bounties. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap, requiring Rank 2 - Curious. Deepmines Caves (Stage 1 zone in all bounties) Muck Bonnet Weapons inflict Toxin Damage. Reeking Puffball Weapons inflict Gas Damage. Player is surrounded by cloudy green effects. Dull Button Clears existing Mushroom effects. Violet's Bane Weapons inflict Viral Damage. Spawns four Clems that follow the player, but their gunfire will harmlessly phase through enemies.

otherSections.heading: Resource Deposits
otherSections.text: Resource Deposits are special containers that hold only a single type of resource. These deposits have a unique name and appearance matching the resource that they contain, and can only be found in the same areas as their associated resource. The rarity of deposits usually corresponds to the rarity of the contained resource; for example, Alloy Drums will be more common than Neural Arrays. Rare resource deposits can drop between 1 to 3 of the associated rare resource. resources.name: Resources
resources.foundText: Resources are items that are obtained in any mission around the Star Chart and can have multiple uses depending on the type of Resource; most of them however are used solely for the manufacturing of other items in the Foundry with Blueprints.

otherSections.heading: Resource Types
otherSections.text: Resources are classified by the method of collection, quantity obtained in each pickup, and their primary purposes. Example(s) Common resources, like the name implies, are very commonly found. They drop from lockers, breakables, normal enemies, and bosses. Nano Spores, Alloy Plate, Salvage Uncommon resources, like the name implies, are found uncommonly in quantities usually between 10 and 30. They drop from lockers, breakables, normal enemies, and bosses. Some of the uncommon Resources are found in higher quantities between 50 and 100. Rubedo, Plastids, Circuits Rare resources will usually drop one at a time. Some drop in higher quantities, like 2 or 3. They are most often found by defeating bosses or a specific type of enemy, and very rarely from common enemies or storage lockers/containers. Orokin Cell, Argon Crystal, Control Module Research resources are resources with a distinctive blue color and are dropped uncommonly from common enemies in quantities of 1 to 3. They are crucial materials for Research. Detonite Ampule, Fieldron Sample, Mutagen Sample Navigators are orbs that are required to build a variety of keys. Like Research Resources, they can be classified as uncommon or rare depending on different factors such as drop rate or quantity obtained. Nav Coordinate s are dropped uncommonly in storage containers. Mutalist Alad V Nav Coordinate, Cryptographic ALU, Omega Isotope These unique resources are usually not dropped by normal enemies, but are obtained as a reward for completing very specific mission types or challenges, or are dropped by specific enemy types (such as Sentient Cores dropped by Sentients ). Some of these resources currently have only one use. Riven Sliver, Kuva, Entropic Kuva, Steel Essence Minerals (ores/gems) Special ores and rough gems are acquired through mining in Landscapes such as the Plains of Eidolon, the Orb Vallis and the Cambion Drift. They can be refined into alloys or cut gems and are usually used for building equipment purchased in Cetus, Fortuna, and the Necralisk. These include Kitguns, K-Drives, Operator Amps, several weapons and Warframes components, MOA companions, Zaws, and Necramechs. Auron, Hesperon, Thaumica Fish are acquired through fishing in the Plains of Eidolon, the Orb Vallis, and the Cambion Drift. Their organs can be extracted and are usually used for building equipment purchased in Cetus, Fortuna, and the Necralisk. They can be used to build the items listed in mining Glappid, Tromyzon, Glutinox Empyrean resources are mostly unique to the Empyrean game mode and have three different rarity types like normal Star Chart resources. They are dropped from enemy fighters, can be found in storage containers inside of Crewships/points of interest, or dropped by destructible items around the space. Carbides, Cubic Diodes, Ticor Plate, and Titanium are also dropped by Eximus units spawning in specific planets. Mainly used for building Railjack components/turrets, but also required for crafting several Warframe parts or weapons. Gallos Rods, Nullstones, Isos Quest / Event -exclusive Exclusive to the quest/event they are tied to, these resources serve no purpose outside of them. Pyrus Essence, Zealot Derelict Code, Corpus Cipher

otherSections.heading: Resource Deposits
otherSections.text: Resource Deposits are special containers that hold only a single type of resource. These deposits have a unique name and appearance matching the resource that they contain, and can only be found in the same areas as their associated resource. The rarity of deposits usually corresponds to the rarity of the contained resource; for example, Alloy Drums will be more common than Neural Arrays. Rare resource deposits can drop between 1 to 3 of the associated rare resource. sapcaddy venedo case.name: Sapcaddy Venedo Case
sapcaddy venedo case.foundText: Sapcaddy Venedo Case is a Resource extracted from Sapcaddy, a Servofish found in lakes during cold weather in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Venedo Case is acquired by dismantling Sapcaddies caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Sapcaddy available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Sapcaddy yields one Venedo Case. This resource also drops from containers in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Venedo Case is acquired by dismantling Sapcaddies caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Sapcaddy available, and select the "Dismantle" option to extract the components.

saturated muscle mass.name: Saturated Muscle Mass
saturated muscle mass.foundText: Saturated Muscle Mass is a resource that can be obtained by filleting Deimos fish.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Saturated Muscle Mass can be obtained by filleting Kymaeros and Ostimyr (both from the Cambion Drift ) at Daughter in the Necralisk. Saturated Muscle Mass can also be bought from Daughter from the "Daily Special" in exchange for Platinum. Note that the "Daily Special" wares are rotating, and Saturated Muscle Mass may not be available. Saturated Muscle Mass can also be found in Ralizor and Spytia Infested Cysts scattered around on the Cambion Drift.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: * Saturated Muscle Mass can be obtained by filleting Kymaeros and Ostimyr (both from the Cambion Drift) at Daughter in the Necralisk.

otherSections.text: Seram Beetle Shells are acquired by cutting up Glappids caught through Fishing. sharrac teeth.foundText: Sharrac Teeth are a Resource extracted from Sharrac, shark-like saltwater fish found in coastlines near Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Sharrac Teeth are acquired by cutting up Sharrac caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Sharrac available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Sharrac cut yields one Sharrac Teeth. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Sharrac Teeth in bundles of 10 or 20 among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought for Platinum.

sibear incarnon genesis.foundText: Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Sibear Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Sibear with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

otherSections.text: Sporulate Sacs can be obtained by filleting Glutinox (from the Cambion Drift ) at Daughter in the Necralisk. Each Glutinox will give 1 Sporulate Sac regardless of size. otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Eidolon Teralyst, Eidolon Gantulyst, and Eidolon Hydrolyst guarantee 1 Steel Essence upon defeat, regardless of kill or capture. Acolytes that spawn in any Steel Path mission guarantee 2 Steel Essence upon defeat. This value is affected by Resource Boosters and Beast's Loyal Retriever and Resourceful Retriever. Every day, six Steel Path Incursion Alerts are available. Each rewards 5 Steel Essence upon completion, to a total of 30 Steel Essence per day. 25 are awarded upon fully clearing all of a planet's mission nodes. A total of 475 are guaranteed for completing the entire Star Chart. 1 is rewarded upon opening a Void Relic in a Steel Path Void Fissure mission. 25 are awarded upon completing Tier 9 of The Circuit on Steel Path. 5 are awarded upon opening the chest for defeating an Orowyrm on Steel Path. 2 are awarded for each extra Undercroft portal completed in Steel Path Duviri Experience, a max of 6 per run. 1 is awarded for clearing the Abyssal Zone on Steel Path. 1 is awarded for beating The Fragmented One on Steel Path. Each week, 25 are awarded upon reaching floor 18 of The Descendia on Steel Path.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Stug Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Stug with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

synathid ecosynth analyzer.name: Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer
synathid ecosynth analyzer.foundText: Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer is a Resource extracted from Synathid, a Servofish found in cave hotspots in Orb Vallis.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer s are acquired by dismantling Synathid s caught through Fishing. Go to The Business in Fortuna, select the desired amount of Synathids available, and select the " Dismantle " option to extract the components. Each Synathid yields one Ecosynth Analyzer. They can also be acquired as a drop from taking down an Exploiter Orb. Each loot yields 7-8 units.

otherSections.text: Upon completing the Tethra's Doom Interception mission on Earth, players will be awarded two fragments regardless of how long they play per session.

tethron antigen.name: Tethron Antigen
tethron antigen.foundText: The Tethron Antigen blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Friend with the Entrati and buying it from Son for 6,000 Standing.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition

thaumic distillate.name: Thaumic Distillate
thaumic distillate.foundText: The reusable blueprint can be purchased from Otak for 4,000 Standing, requiring Rank 2 - Acquaintance with the Entrati.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: The reusable blueprint can be purchased from Otak for 4,000 Standing, requiring Rank 2 - Acquaintance with the Entrati.

thaumica.name: Thaumica
thaumica.foundText: Thaumica is a rare ore found in yellow mineral veins in the Cambion Drift.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Mining yellow mineral veins in Cambion Drift. It is commonly found in Infested Seraglio cave system. Requiem Obelisks have a chance to drop Thaumica when the kill condition of the Obelisk is satisfied (usually killing with the operator or Necramech ). Spitia Infested Cysts (rare) occasionally found on the Cambion Drift (seemingly one placed at Albrecht's Prospect region)

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: *Mining yellow mineral veins in Cambion Drift. It is commonly found in Infested Seraglio cave system.

the countessa comic.name: The Countessa Comic
the countessa comic.foundText: The Countessa Comic is a Hex Treasure found within Höllvania.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: The Countessa Comics can be found scattered across any Höllvania missions as an interactable pickup. Tier 1 Bounties from the Bounty Board have a chance to award The Countessa Comic.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: *The Countessa Comics can be found scattered across any Höllvania missions as an interactable pickup.

thermal sludge.name: Thermal Sludge
thermal sludge.foundText: Thermal Sludge is resource that can be found in special containers located in Corpus encampments all over Orb Vallis. It is also rewarded by Bounties.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Thorn Tooth can be harvested in the Deepmines Nutrient Plant of Weed The Garden Deepmines Bounty. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap at Rank 0 - Neutral. Deepmines Nutrient Plant (Stage 2-5 zone in Weed The Garden bounty) Blister Stalk Weapons inflict Heat Damage. Spawns six false Syzygy Shockwave MOAs that surround and follow the player while dancing in place. Thorn Tooth Weapons inflict Puncture Damage. Both the player and any enemies they damage will be impaled with ethereal Skana s. Gamma Berry Weapons inflict Radiation Damage. The player's head temporarily inflates. Weapons inflict Void Damage. Player is surrounded by Void energy, audible laughter plays on pickup, and the buff description reads "Is someone watching?"

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: * can be harvested in the Deepmines Nutrient Plant of Weed The Garden Deepmines Bounty.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Thunder-Button can be harvested in the Deepmines Labs of the Critter Liberation Deepmines Bounty. May be awarded randomly as a bonus bounty reward at the end of the mission, appearing just beside the extraction elevator. Can be purchased for 10 Fergolyte from Nightcap, requiring Rank 1 - Unknowing. Deepmines Lab (Stage 2-5 zone in Critter Liberation bounty) Thunder-Button Weapons inflict Electricity Damage. The player's movement speed and melee attack speed increases, as if under the effects of Speed. Devil's Cap Weapons inflict Slash Damage. The player's eyes glow bright red. Damaging enemies will cosmetically sever limbs and create additional blood and gore effects. Weapons inflict Magnetic Damage. Player is followed by a group of Sprodlings that match their Warframe's colors. Vomval Trumpet Weapons inflict Tau Damage. Spawns a false Eidolon Vomvalyst that floats near the player.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: * can be harvested in the Deepmines Labs of the Critter Liberation Deepmines Bounty.

thyst.name: Thyst
thyst.foundText: Mined from blue mineral veins in Orb Vallis with the Advanced Nosam Cutter or the Sunpoint Plasma Drill, each yielding 1 unit. Dropped as a common loot of Exploiter Orb, each loot yielding 7-8 units.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Mined from blue mineral veins in Orb Vallis with the Advanced Nosam Cutter or the Sunpoint Plasma Drill, each yielding 1 unit. Also available from red veins in Orb Vallis upon hitting the square bracket bonus spot. Dropped as a common loot of Exploiter Orb, each loot yielding 7-8 units. On rarer occasions, the grand boss may drop multiple instances of the loot, making it possible to get 14-16 or even 21-24 units per kill.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Combining Crimson and Amber creates a Topaz Archon Shard. Combining Tauforged Crimson and Tauforged Amber creates a Tauforged Topaz Archon Shard. Combining three Topaz creates a Tauforged Topaz Archon Shard. Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. toroid.foundText: Toroids are rare resources that can be acquired from enemies or in caves as a rare item in Orb Vallis. Presumably the power sources for various Corpus Raknoids on the Vallis, these items act as either a normal pickup when dropped by enemies, or as an interactable object if found in caves.

tralok eyes.foundText: Tralok Eyes are a Resource extracted from Tralok, a saltwater fish found in coastlines near Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Tralok Eyes are acquired by cutting up Tralok caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Tralok available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Tralok cut yields one Tralok Eyes. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Tralok Eyes in bundles of 20 among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought for Platinum. Tusk Thumper can also drop them.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Combining Crimson and Azure creates a Violet Archon Shard. Combining Tauforged Crimson and Tauforged Azure creates a Tauforged Violet Archon Shard. Combining three Violets creates a Tauforged Violet Archon Shard. Archon Shards are awarded from Archon Hunts: Crimson from Archon Amar, Amber from Archon Nira, and Azure from Archon Boreal. The Shard has an 80% chance of being a normal variant and 20% of being Tauforged. If a normal variant is awarded, the chance of receiving a Tauforged increases by 20% which resets upon earning one, tracked individually for each shard type. Taking the increasing drop rates after not getting a Tauforged into consideration, the effective chance for a Tauforged is around 39.83%. Crimson, Amber, and Azure Archon Shards are available as common loot from the Netracells or Deep Archimedea, with their Tauforged variants able to be rolled as rare loot. Topaz, Violet, and Emerald Archon Shards are primarily obtainable through Coalescent Fusion of two Crimson, Amber, and Azure Shards. All normal shards, not including the coalescent shards, are possible prizes from the Steel Path version of The Descendia after completing Infernum 21. All shards, including Coalescent and Tauforged Shards, can be obtained as rewards from Temporal Archimedea. otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Void Traces are primarily obtained by collecting Reactant in Void Fissure missions, which drops from Corrupted enemies, awarding 6-30 Void Traces upon collection of the 10th Reactant. Players are not required to have a Void Relic equipped to obtain Traces. When selecting opened Void Relic rewards, the player owning an opened relic gains 5 bonus Void Traces per teammate (excluding self) who picks the reward that came from their own relic. Thus, up to a total of 15 bonus Traces are obtained if the rest of the team picks their reward. Granum Void Rank 1 reward contains 5 / 10 / 15 Void Traces for Normal/Extended/Nightmare Tiers. Isolation Vaults contain storage containers that, when broken, may drop Void Traces. Unlike most resources, there is an upper limit to how many Void Traces a player can stockpile. This cap is determined by one's Mastery Rank using the formula: (Mastery Rank × 50) + 100. For example, a player at Mastery Rank 13 can hold up to 750 Void Traces, while at Mastery Rank 30 one can hold up to 1600. Increasing one's Mastery Rank will immediately increase Void Trace storage capacity. Excess Void Traces are discarded, except that excess Void Traces reclaimed upon defeating a Kuva Lich are retained.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: After Fass kills Vome to begin the Fass cycle on the Cambion Drift, small zones of blue energy will appear in various locations. Entering a zone will cover the edges of the screen in blue sludge and grant a temporary %? movement speed bonus to all Infested and Necramechs (both player-controlled and AI-controlled) within the zone, as well as a speed penalty to all Tenno (including Warframes, Operators, and Archwings, though K-Drives are exempt). Multiple deposits of Vome Residue will spawn inside each zone and can be destroyed to acquire 1 Vome Residue each. Note that if one stays in the Cambion Drift for long enough, there may be Vome Residue on the map even though Vome is active.

yogwun stomach.name: Yogwun Stomach
yogwun stomach.foundText: The Yogwun Stomach is a Resource extracted from Yogwun, a freshwater fish found in lakes around Cetus.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Yogwun Stomachs are acquired by cutting up Yogwun caught through Fishing. Go to Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus, select the desired amount of Yogwun available, and select the " Cut Fish " option to extract the components. Each Yogwun cut yields one Yogwun Stomach. Alternatively, Fisher Hai-Luk can sell Yogwun Stomachs in bundles of 20 among her rotating stock of " Daily Specials ", which can be bought for Platinum.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Mined from blue mineral veins in Orb Vallis with the Advanced Nosam Cutter or the Sunpoint Plasma Drill, each yielding 1 unit. Also available from red veins in Orb Vallis upon hitting the square bracket bonus spot. Dropped as a common loot of Exploiter Orb, each loot yielding 7-8 units. On rarer occasions, the grand boss may drop multiple instances of the loot, making it possible to get 14-16 or even 21-24 units per kill.

zylok incarnon genesis.name: Zylok Incarnon Genesis
zylok incarnon genesis.foundText: Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation.

otherSections.heading: Acquisition
otherSections.text: Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Zylok Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Zylok with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.
